en: The Section on Detailed Exposition, Chapter Five: Convergence (Sampāta)
The Application of the Mode of Conveying Characteristics: In this context, what is the application of the mode of conveying characteristics?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range is right intention.”
“Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range is right intention”—this refers to the faculty of mindfulness; when the faculty of mindfulness is grasped, all five faculties are thereby grasped.
“Having right view as the foremost”—when right view is grasped, the Noble Eightfold Path is thereby grasped.
For from right view, right intention arises; from right intention, right speech arises; from right speech, right action arises;
from right action, right livelihood arises; from right livelihood, right effort arises;
from right effort, right mindfulness arises; and from right mindfulness, right concentration arises.
From right concentration, right liberation arises; from right liberation, the knowledge and vision of right liberation arises.
The section on the Modes of Conveying Characteristics is concluded.
